content.title: Chime outage causing problems for thousands
content.text: NEWSIs Chime down right now? Chime app down for many usersAsbury Park PressApril 1, 2026, 1:45 p.m. ET0:01/0:42Keep WatchingIf you're looking to log onto Chime, you could find problems.According to Downdetector, users are having problems using the financial technology company. The bugs popped up April 1 shortly before 1 p.m. EST.According to the site, the biggest problem is on the app, where nearly 80 percent of the problems were listed.
